question: Calculate \((3+i)(3-i)\).
solution: The factors \(3+i\) and \(3-i\) are conjugates, so their product equals \(|3+i|^2\). The square of the modulus is \(9+1=10\).

solutionMethods.explanation:
The factors have the same real term and opposite imaginary terms, so the difference of squares formula applies. Using \(i^2=-1\),
\[
(3+i)(3-i)=3^2-i^2=9+1=10.
\]
solutionMethods.label: Difference of squares
